title: Titīrṣā's Lexicon
author: Joseph and Alisha Lewis, with Claude

p: This is the Lexicon that Titīrṣā, Instrument 04 of the Unified Lewis Framework, uses to turn the words of a goal or an event into one of the 27 tones. We approved it on 16 November 2026.

Each of the 27 tones holds words. The codex words come from the tone's own entry in the Aetheria Tone Codex: its function name, its hexagram and Legge's Judgment, its Moon mansion, its geometry and its line in the framework. Each carries the line it comes from. The everyday words are ordinary words placed by that meaning.

A word ending in three dots matches every word that starts that way, so friend… matches friendly and friendship. A plain word also matches its common endings. A word marked half weight belongs partly to a second tone and counts half there.

When you write a goal, each word that belongs to a tone sounds it. The three strongest tones make a chord, and the chord comes to one tone as in the Regime Collider: the geometric mean of their pitches, then the nearest of the 27.
Health words are placed as a part of life, the body, and never as anything a tone does for it.
